scientific_integrity: The proof of the all-time distribution uses a full binary coding bijection and word-avoidance recurrence; finite brute-force checks test but do not replace the all-parameter and infinite-time argument.
scientific_limitations: The assertions are confined to negative doubling with symmetric dyadic central open holes and Lebesgue initial data. Standard finite-type entropy/dimension correspondences are prior mathematics. General automata methods may imply the individual finite-resolution distributions, and a not-yet-identified explicit historical equivalent may exist. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
title: Exact multinacci escape statistics for symmetric dyadic holes of the negative-doubling map
